crossRefs.note: So you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.
I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you…
“If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be…
A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding:
Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds:
When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be…
not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

translations.web: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
translations.bsb: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
translations.kjv: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
translations.asv: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.
